portInfo.description: Tauranga is a cruise call—confirm your berth on the daily programme before you plan the day.

facts.established: Established as a European settlement in the early 19th century
facts.significance: New Zealand's largest port by gross tonnage

size.citySize: Fifth largest urban area in New Zealand

climate.description: Warm-temperate climate with mild winters and warm summers

politics.visaRequirements: Visa or NZeTA required for most visitors. Visa waiver for some nationalities.
politics.entryRequirements: Valid passport required. NZeTA or visa required for most visitors.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Port of Tauranga cruise berth (Mount Maunganui / Pilot Bay) — Mount Maunganui, Tauranga, New Zealand
gettingThere.publicTransport: The port cites easy access to Tauranga city and Bay of Plenty attractions. Shuttle provision varies by sailing — confirm with your ship. Taxis and rideshare are available; confirm pricing locally.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Mount Maunganui summit / beaches — iconic short call.
Rotorua / Hobbiton — long day; only with confirmed timing.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not go to Sulphur Point container gates looking for the cruise gangway.
